architect.interface.description.AlterEdg: An edge interpreter interface that captures attribute data via a form.
architect.interface.description.AlterFor: An interface that allows the participant to fill out a form for each alter in the interview network.
architect.interface.description.Anonymis: An interface that allows the participant to set a passphrase for node anonymisation.
architect.interface.description.Categori: A name interpreter interface that collects nominal data by allowing the participant to drag and drop alters into circles representing a category.
architect.interface.description.DyadCens: A name interpreter interface that creates edges by systematically surveying all alters in the interview network.
architect.interface.description.EgoForm: An interface that collects data on your participant (ego).
architect.interface.description.FamilyPe: An interface for collecting family pedigrees, allowing for the capture of complex family relationships and attributes as well as hereditary disease information.
architect.interface.description.Geospati: An interface that captures geospatial data by allowing the user to select items on a map
architect.interface.description.Informat: A general purpose screen that can be used to present information to participants using a variety of text and media resources.
architect.interface.description.NameGene: A name generator interface which provides a form that participants complete when creating an alter.
A name generator interface designed for low response-burden. Only requires a label in order to create an alter.
A name generator specifically for roster data, allowing sorting and filtering of the roster.
architect.interface.description.Narrativ: A qualitative interface that uses "presets" to switch between different views of the data in the network.
A read-only visualisation interface that overlays disease status and inheritance patterns onto a family pedigree collected by a Family Pedigree stage.
architect.interface.description.NetworkC: A free-form, single-screen canvas for building a whole network — create nodes, draw multiple edge types, and capture node and edge attributes in one place.
architect.interface.description.OneToMan: A name interpreter interface that creates edges by systematically surveying one alter against many others in the interview network.
architect.interface.description.OrdinalB: A name interpreter interface that captures ordinal data by allowing the participant to drag and drop alters into bins.
architect.interface.description.Sociogra: Designed for spatially arranging alters (either manually or automatically), creating edges between them, and highlighting the presence of alter attributes.
architect.interface.description.TieStren: Combines a dyad census with an ordinal attribute to simultaneously capture the strength of ties between alters.
